arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَيَجَـانِ الْحِرْصِ ، وَسَوْرَةِ الغَضَبِ وَغَلَبَةِ الْحَسَدِ وضَعْفِ الصَّبْرِ وَقِلَّةِ الْقَنَاعَةِ وَشَكَاسَةِ الْخُلُقِ ، وَإلْحَاحِ الشَّهْوَةِ ، وَمَلَكَةِ الْحَمِيَّةِ ،
transliteration: allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min hayajāni al-hirṣi wa sawratil-ghadab wa ghalabatil-hasad wa ḍaʿfil-ṣabr wa qillatil qana'ati wa shakasatil khuluq wa'ilhāḥi al-shahwati, wa-malakati al-ḥamiyyah
english_text: O God, I seek refuge in Thee from the agitation of craving, the violence of wrath, the domination of envy, the frailty of patience, the lack of contentment, surliness of character, urgency of passion, the disposition to vehemence,

arabic_text: وَمُتَابَعَةِ الْهَوَى ، وَمُخَالَفَةِ الْهُدَى ، وَسِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ ، وَتَعَاطِي الْكُلْفَةِ ، وَإيْثَارِ الْبَاطِلِ عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَالإصْرَارِ عَلَى الْمَأثَمِ ، وَاسْتِصْغَـارِ الْمَعْصِيَـةِ ، وَاسْتِكْثَارِ الطَّاعَةِ ،
transliteration: wa mutābaʿati al-hawā, wa mukhālafati al-hudā wa sinati al-ghaflah, wa ta'atii al-kulfah wa ʾīthāri l-bāṭili ʿalā l-ḥaqqi wal-iṣrāri ʿalā l-maʾṯami wa-istiṣghāri al-maʿṣiyati, wa-istikhtāri al-ṭāʿati
english_text: following caprice, opposing guidance, the sleep of heedlessness, undertaking the toilsome, preferring falsehood over truth, persisting in sin, making little of disobedience, making much of obedience,

arabic_text: وَمُبَاهَاةِ الْمُكْثِرِينَ ، وَالإزْرآءِ بِالْمُقِلِّينَ ، وَسُوءِ الْوِلاَيَةِ لِمَنْ تَحْتَ أَيْدِينَا وَتَرْكِ الشُّكْرِ لِمَنِ اصْطَنَعَ الْعَارِفَةَ عِنْدَنَا ، أَوْ أَنْ نَعْضُدَ ظَالِماً ، أَوْ نَخْذُلَ مَلْهُوفاً ،
transliteration: wa mubāhāti l-mukthirīna, wa al-izrāʾi bil-muqillīna wa suu'il-wilāyati liman tahta aydeena wa tarqil shukri limani istana'a al-'arifata 'indana aw an naʿḍuda ẓāliman, aw nakhẓula malhūfan
english_text: vying with the wealthy, distitleging the poor, guarding badly over those in our hands, failing to thank those who have done good to us, aiding a wrongdoer, abandoning someone troubled,

arabic_text: أَوْ نَرُومَ مَا لَيْسَ لَنَا بِحَقّ، أَوْ نَقُولَ فِي الْعِلْمِْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْم
transliteration: aw narooma ma laysa lana bihaqqa aw naqūla fī al-ʿilm bi-ghayr ʿilm
english_text: wanting what is not rightfully ours, and speaking about knowledge without knowing.

arabic_text: وَنَعُـوذُ بِـكَ أَنْ نَنْطَوِيَ عَلَى غِشِّ أَحَد ، وَأَنْ نُعْجَبَ بِأَعْمَالِنَا ، وَنَمُدَّ فِي آمَالِنَا ،
transliteration: wa-naʿuẓu bi-ka an nanṭawiya ʿalā ghishshi aḥad wa'an nuʿjaba bi-aʿmālinā, wa namudda fī āmālinā
english_text: We seek refuge in Thee from harbouring dishonesty toward anyone, being pleased with our works, and stretching out our expectations.

arabic_text: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سُوءِ السَّرِيرَةِ ، وَاحْتِقَارِ الصَّغِيرَةِ ، وَأَنْ يَسْتَحْوِذَ عَلَيْنَا الشَّيْطَانُ ، أَوْ يَنْكُبَنَـا الزَّمَانُ ، أَوْ يَتَهَضَّمَنَا السُّلْطَانُ.
transliteration: wa naʿūḏu bika min suu'i al-sarīra, wa-iḥtiqāri al-ṣaghīra wa'an yastahwizu 'alayna ash-shaytan 'aw yankubanna al-zamanu, 'aw yatahadhamana al-sultanu
english_text: We seek refuge in Thee from ill-mindedness, looking down on the small, Satan's gaining mastery over us, time's afflicting us, and the sovereign's oppressing us.

arabic_text: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ تَنَاوُلِ الإسْرَافِ ، وَمِنْ فِقْدَانِ الْكَفَـافِ
transliteration: wa-naʿūdh bi-ka min tanāwul al-isrāf, wa min fiqdan al-kafāf
english_text: We seek refuge in Thee from acting with prodigality and not having sufficiency.

arabic_text: وَنَعُوذُ بِـكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاءِ وَمِنَ الْفَقْرِ إلَى الاَكْفَاءِ وَمِنْ مَعِيشَة فِي شِدَّة وَمَيْتَة عَلَى غَيْـرِ عُدَّة.
transliteration: wa naʿūdh bi-ka min shamātati al-aʿdā'i wa min al-faqr ilā al-akfāʾi wa min maʿīshat fī shiddah wa maytah ʿalā ghayr ʿuddah
english_text: We seek refuge in Thee from the gloating of enemies, indigent need for equals, living in hardship, and dying without readiness.

arabic_text: وَنَعُـوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْحَسْرَةِ الْعُظْمى ، وَالْمُصِيبَةِ الْكُبْرَى ، وَأَشْقَى الشَّقَآءِ وَسُوءِ المآبِ ، وَحِرْمَانِ الثَّوَابِ ، وَحُلُولِ الْعِقَابِ.
transliteration: wa naʿūdhu bika min al-ḥasrat al-ʿuẓmā wa-al-muṣībat al-kubrā, wa-ashqā al-shaqā' wa-sū'i al-māb wa hirmāni althawābi, wa ḥulūli alʿiqāb
english_text: We seek refuge in Thee from the most dreadful remorse, the greatest affliction, the most wretched wretchedness, the evil end to the journey, the deprivation of reward, and the advent of punishment.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ، وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ ذَلِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيـعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa'a'ithni min kulli dhalika bi rahmatika wa jamiʿa al-mu'minīna wa al-mu'mināti
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and through Thy mercy, give to me refuge from all of that, and to all the faithful, both men and women!
O Most Merciful of the merciful!
